comment: Obstacle room of the dev sandbox (stairs at the north edge of the terrain sandbox, R to draw again). Each visit draws 'features' different kinds among 'pool' (weight: how often). chasm / river: a band 'width' tiles wide across the arena, wandering a little, over 'coverage' of the width (1 = wall to wall, the default), with 'bridges' crossings (river: 'fordKind' tiles instead of bridges when set); lake: a blob of 'kind' of size S, M or L (radius in tiles); ice_walls: 'count' short walls. boulders: 'count' rocks, 'bigChance' of them big (2 x 2); pylons: 'count' pairs 'distance' tiles apart; metal: a patch of plates of radius 'sizes' with 'magnets' magnets on its edge; island: land of radius 'sizes' ringed by 'width' tiles of 'kind', reached by 'bridges' straight bridges. Bands are placed first; bridges sit where a band runs straight. Nothing is placed within 'spawnClear' tiles of the centre or 'stairsClear' of the stairs; 'separate': obstacles that never touch (at least 'gap' tiles of floor between them); a layout that cuts the room in two is drawn again.
